title: Tensor compatibility of derived inverse-image composition
statement: For any Grothendieck abelian symmetric closed monoidal coefficient category V₀ with the stated functorial flat resolutions and flat-preserving pro-etale inverse images, and scheme arrows s:U→V and b:V→X, the canonical derived inverse-image compositor P_(sb)→P_s P_b commutes with the canonical derived tensor comparisons. For all unbounded M,N on X, c_(M⊗N); P_s(mu_b); mu_s = mu_(sb); (c_M⊗c_N). The maps are the published leftDerivedUpperStarComp and leftDerivedUpperStarTensorIso.

source.place: Tag 07A4 (pullback and tensor product), with sites.tex Tag 03EL (composition of inverse images); derived monoidal-composition calculation for the proper/open tensor square

proof.text: The ordinary upperStar compositor is monoidal by conjugating the monoidal lowerStar compositor under the inverse-image/direct-image adjunctions. Apply the existing source-library map_leftDerivedTensorComparison_app_app_comp to the two inverse images; expand the derived compositor, cancel its hom/inv pair, and apply leftDerivedTensorComparison_naturality_app for the ordinary compositor. Combine the two tensor maps with tensorHom_comp_tensorHom and rewrite the curried tensor as the displayed uncurry map.

theorem properOpenPullTensorComposition
    (V₀ : Type*) [Category.{u + 1} V₀] [Abelian V₀]
    [IsGrothendieckAbelian.{u + 1} V₀] [MonoidalCategory V₀]
    [MonoidalPreadditive V₀] [SymmetricCategory V₀] [MonoidalClosed V₀]
    [Abelian.HasFunctorialFlatResolution V₀] [UpperStarPreservesFlat V₀]
    {U V X : Scheme.{u}} (s : U ⟶ V) (b : V ⟶ X)
    (M N : DerivedCategory (Sheaf (Scheme.ProEt.topology X) V₀)) :
    (leftDerivedUpperStarComp (V₀) s b).hom.app
        (((derivedTensor V₀ X).obj M).obj N) ≫
      ((upperStar V₀ s).leftDerivedFunctor).map (leftDerivedUpperStarTensorIso
        (V₀) b M N).hom ≫
      (leftDerivedUpperStarTensorIso (V₀) s
        (((upperStar V₀ b).leftDerivedFunctor).obj M)
        (((upperStar V₀ b).leftDerivedFunctor).obj N)).hom =
    (leftDerivedUpperStarTensorIso (V₀) (s ≫ b) M N).hom ≫
      (Functor.uncurry.obj (derivedTensor V₀ U)).map
        (Prod.mkHom
          ((leftDerivedUpperStarComp (V₀) s b).hom.app M)
          ((leftDerivedUpperStarComp (V₀) s b).hom.app N))
